p: all the mixed multitude: That is, all who had joined in unlawful marriage and also those with whom God had forbidden them to mingle with.
this: That the separation was made.
allied unto Tobiah: He was united with Tobiah the Ammonite the enemy of the Jews.
Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I: Called also Darius, Ezr 6:1.

the evil that Eliashib did for: Thus we see to what inconveniences the people fall into when they are destitute of one who fears God, seeing that their chief governor was absent only for a little while and yet they fell into such great absurdities: as appears in, Ex 32:1.

good deeds that I have done: He protests that he did his duty with a good conscience yet he does not justify himself in it, but desires God to favour him and to be merciful to him for his own goodness' sake, as in Ne 13:22,31.
I testified against them in the: I declared to them that God would not allow such transgressors of his law to go unpunished.
thus: Was this not the reason God plagued us in times past: meaning, that if they transgressed now in the same way, their plague would be greater.
dark before the sabbath: About the time that the sun went down, for the sabbath lasted from the sun setting one day, to the sun setting the next day.
keep the gates: Meaning, of the temple that none that was unclean should enter.
Ashdod: Which was a city of the Philistines and they had married wives from it and so had corrupted their speech and religion.
cursed them: That is, I excommunicated them and drove them out of the congregation.
defiled the priesthood: Punish them according to their sin and the evil example they have given to the rest of the people contrary to their calling.
for good: That is, to show mercy to me.
